scope: A10 RTL CDC hardening: remove raw EMIF cal_fail from CPU-domain adapter control, add per-domain FSM reset release chains, and route calibration_gate status flops through those synchronized resets.

changes.summary: Split reset synchronizers into FSM reset (cpu_fsm_rst_n/emif_fsm_rst_n, no cal_fail) and FIFO epoch reset (cpu_fifo_rst_n/emif_fifo_rst_n, includes calibration failure); replace raw cpu_domain_rst_n in CPU/EMIF FSM reset with per-domain synchronized reset; replace raw cal_fail in CPU control with cal_failed_cpu/cal_abort_cpu.
Change reset ports to adapter-provided per-domain synchronized resets (cpu_rst_n_sync/emif_rst_n_sync); source-domain fail latch and CPU status synchronizers reset only in their own domain.

source_evidence.root_cause: EMIF adapter used raw cal_fail in CPU-domain control and CPU reset as an asynchronous reset of EMIF-side FSM; SDC false paths were only a constraint stand-in, not RTL synchronization.

runs.output: PASS: B2 AXI4/Avalon SV regression writes=0 reads=0

known_limits: No Quartus/Qsys synthesis, fitter, signoff STA, TimeQuest Report CDC, assembler/SOF, or board reset/calibration stress was run.
tb/** was treated as read-only in this task, so no new dedicated CDC directed test file was added; existing B2 SV regression was rerun and passed.
Post-fit STA must confirm recovery/removal on the new FSM/FIFO reset synchronizer hierarchy; SDC wildcard names cpu_rst_sync0_n*/emif_rst_sync0_n* remain compatible with the kept first-stage naming.
next: Have integrator merge, then rerun FP-P4 functional and FP-P5 synthesis/fitter/signoff STA on the merged SHA; only all timing non-negative and DDR pass permits assembler/SOF.

integrator_review.notes: A10 RTL CDC/reset hardening merged and accepted
